review_method: Four independent source audits mapped each assigned semantic piece to its destination. A fifth reviewer checked skill composition and three independent entry paths. Reviewers rechecked affected pieces after fixes; unchanged evidence was reused.
locator_scope: Source locators refer to base_revision. Destination locators identify the reviewed sections; initial findings retain historical line numbers. Final file hashes identify the integrated result.

recheck.scope: Re-read only the repaired component caveat and authoring routing passage. The automatic router choice was reviewed as an accepted design decision.

pieces.note: The router gives table work a direct entry point. The table skill owns source-level structure, formatting, and renderer choice, so the task can finish without report run/render; it records requested outputs as verified or unverified. The report-delivery host check is conditional for target representations.

The component skill explicitly supports use without creating a report and owns semantic input, configuration, and projections. The rechecked no-framework caveat keeps the one-component/entry/configuration constraint unconditional, and gates one-edit locality and one-section wiring behind report integration.

The delivery skill has an independent existing-report path: inspect saved artifacts first, read an existing receipt, run browser verification only when current evidence is needed, and rebuild only when source or stale artifacts require it. No analysis execution is required by this path; the recheck did not change this route.

findings.note: Historical observation: the broad router is model-invoked because it has a description and no disable-model-invocation flag. The skill mechanics recommend a user-invoked router when it serves only as the human index, which avoids permanent context load and competing broad triggers.
findings.resolution: The automatic choice is deliberate. It permits model routing from a broad report task as well as direct user invocation. No change is required unless the repository later chooses an explicit-only router.

findings.rule: Independent skill entry points must not impose a neighboring workflow; a pointer must encode the branch that triggers it.

findings.resolution: The passage now keeps one component, entry point, and configuration dataclass unconditional, then says 'When integrating it into a report' before applying one-edit locality and one-section wiring. The component-only route is independent.

reviews.overall: After recheck, all three requested entry paths are reachable and independent. The component-only route and authoring-to-table route are repaired. summary.limitations: These are source-preservation and routing reviews, not new runtime or upstream API validation. Existing code examples and evidence claims were preserved.
